analysis: What changed vs the 9:00 AM brief yesterday: the story flipped overnight. Nvidia delivered the beat-and-raise the tape was de-risking against — Q3 revenue $115.84B (+103% YoY) vs ~$109.1B expected, adj EPS $2.68 vs $2.47, and a Q4 guide of $130B vs $125.25B consensus — and futures turned green (Nasdaq-100 +1.17%, S&P +0.62% at 4:53 AM ET) after the fourth straight down day. Two caveats keep this from being a clean all-clear: the Q4 guide covers a 14-week quarter, so per-week revenue is ~$9.29B vs ~$8.91B in Q3 — still a beat, but smaller than the headline gap; and the board definitively closed the Huang door on the call (chair Harvey Jones: the board does not intend to reinstate him), so the governance overhang now runs on the board's CEO search and Bessent's ~Nov 25 deadline, not a comeback. The supply-commitments jump ($279B to $390B, mostly multi-year memory procurement) is the strongest forward-demand signal in the print. Retail split the morning: Target beat big and raised guidance (EPS $2.65 incl. a $0.50 tariff-refund benefit, comps +5.6%) and is up premarket, while Lowe's also beat ($3.10 vs $2.88) and raised its sales outlook yet trades down ~3% — a reminder that the reaction, not the beat, is the price signal. The AI hardware complex is rallying with Nvidia (AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Marvell, CoreWeave all up) while the four big AI spenders barely move, so the bounce is concentrated in suppliers, not buyers. Oil and gold sliding together (WTI -2.59% on a 5.28M-barrel API build; gold -2.41%) plus a VIX easing from Tuesday's 25.46 close to ~24.19 premarket reads as risk appetite returning, not a flight to safety. Signal vs noise: the Nvidia print is genuine signal — it removes the single biggest overhang into the open — but it does not resolve the governance questions (Bessent deadline, Dec 1 Huang testimony) or the December-hike path, which the 2:00 PM ET FOMC minutes will speak to. Community: no qualifying thread — the HN Algolia query returned only older stories (latest relevant Aug 2026), and the site search showed only Nov 12-14 Nvidia threads.

headlines.headline: Nvidia beat and raised after the close: Q3 revenue $115.84B (+103% YoY) vs ~$109.1B expected, adj EPS $2.68 vs $2.47; Q4 guide $130B (+/-3%) vs $125.25B consensus. Supply commitments jumped to $390B from $279B. Board chair Harvey Jones said on the call the board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang; interim CEO Colette Kress leads. Shares +2.9% premarket (~$159.95 at 4:27 AM ET).
headlines.why_it_matters: The biggest overhang into the open is gone — the beat plus a raised guide is why futures flipped green after four straight down days.

headlines.why_it_matters: A green open would snap the four-day losing streak, but the bounce is Nvidia-led and narrow — breadth at the open decides whether it holds.
